name: os-shell
description: OS Shell — thin browser-hosted runtime for web apps and Digiconomy-native apps. Not a primitive.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @osshell/contract && npm run build -w @osshell/runtime && npm run build -w @osshell/sdk && npm run build -w @osshell/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @osshell/contract && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/contract && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/web && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/demo-notes
scripts.test: npm run build -w @osshell/contract && npm run build -w @osshell/runtime && npm run build -w @osshell/sdk && node --import tsx --test packages/contract/test/*.test.ts packages/runtime/test/*.test.ts
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @osshell/web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
